8-Day Ancient Turkey Tour: Troy to Ephesus
summary:
The 8-Day Istanbul, Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus & Pamukkale Tour follows Turkey’s history across very different periods, from Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine heritage to the First World War battlefields of Gallipoli and the ancient civilizations of the Aegean. Along the way, explore Troy, the Acropolis of Pergamon and Ephesus before reaching Pamukkale, where the white travertine terraces rise beside ancient Hierapolis.
Available year-round, the itinerary can be adjusted around your travel dates when needed. We arrange selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, one domestic flight, airport transfers and the sightseeing specified in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Gallipoli Tour & Transfer to Canakkale
itinerary.text: At 07:00, depart for Eceabat. Upon arrival, enjoy lunch before beginning the guided Gallipoli campaign Battlefields and Memorials Tour. Visit important sites including Anzac Cove, Lone Pine Australian Memorial, Johnston’s Jolly, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair New Zealand Memorial. After the tour, cross by ferry to Canakkale and check in to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: Troy & Pergamon Tour – Kusadasi
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:45, depart for the ancient city of Troy, famous for the legendary Trojan Horse and the stories of Helen of Troy. Discover the fascinating history of this UNESCO World Heritage Site, where nine ancient cities were built over one another dating back to 3500 BC. Continue to Pergamon for lunch and a guided tour of the Acropolis, including the steepest theatre of the ancient world and the Temple of Trajan. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Day Trip
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” one of Turkey’s most remarkable natural wonders. Continue to the ancient city of Hierapolis and enjoy free time to swim at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus Tour & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. After the tour, transfer to Izmir Airport for your evening flight to Istanbul at 19:00. Upon arrival at 20:00, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Half day Morning Bosphorus Cruise
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia on one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, return to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8-Day Turkey Package?
faqs.a: The 8-Day Turkey Package covers Istanbul, Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Pamukkale, and Ephesus. You will explore Istanbul's famous landmarks, visit the historic battlefields of Gallipoli, discover the legendary city of Troy, tour the ancient Acropolis of Pergamon, walk through the remarkable ruins of Ephesus, and experience the stunning white terraces of Pamukkale. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Turkey Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,375 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, one domestic flight, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Is a domestic flight included in this 8-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes one domestic flight as specified in the itinerary. This flight helps reduce travel time and provides a comfortable way to connect between destinations while maximizing your sightseeing opportunities.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide
faqs.a: The package includes 7 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the tour are included.

faqs.q: Does the 8-Day Turkey Package include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural context, and local expertise throughout your journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors interested in Turkey's rich history and archaeology. It combines some of the country's most important ancient cities, World War I battlefields, and natural wonders into one comprehensive itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and memorial areas. Locations such as Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, and Pamukkale involve moderate walking on uneven terrain, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, and Pamukkale?
faqs.a: Highlights include Anzac Cove and the memorials of Gallipoli, the legendary Trojan Horse and ruins of Troy, the Acropolis of Pergamon, the Library of Celsus and Great Theatre in Ephesus, and Pamukkale's famous travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8-Day Turkey Package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 8-Day Turkey Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
